role: eFuse local IN/OUT bypass and CdVdt routing reviewer
status: Final native 24d scoped eFuse verification passed
ratingBasis: Whole-board routing judgment informed by the Source23 team baseline and independently checked actual 24d eFuse/power-interface geometry. This reviewer did not repeat every other routing domain audit.
strengths: OUT bypass is now 3.174 mm all-top with a nearby independent ground return, replacing 23.026 mm and two transfers in the bypass path.
CdVdt complete signal is roughly halved, its main-ground-plane cut is removed, and its local capacitor ground escape is 0.98 mm.

Actual native 24d geometry verifies 18 finite endpoint contacts and at least 0.207303 mm foreign-copper clearance across the scoped routes, capacitor pads and through barrels, including regenerated pours.

residualRisks.finding: No dedicated local IN bypass capacitor was added. The nearest actual VBUS_RAW capacitor C_PD_VDD remains 14.422205 mm from U_INPUT center. Long collector copper cannot establish a compact IN-to-cap-to-GND transient loop.
residualRisks.recommendation: A future local IN bypass placement and collector review is the principal remaining eFuse improvement.

residualRisks.finding: CdVdt still has two full-through signal transfers and a 5.568 mm route. Its plane-return loop and quiet/star-ground quality are improved geometrically but not bench-validated.
